query: select timestamp, log_attributes['res.statusCode'] as status, log_attributes['error.errorCode'] as error_code, log_attributes['error.name'] as error_name, log_attributes['error.message'] as message from logs where source = 'storage_logs' and log_attributes['res.statusCode'] = '429' order by timestamp desc limit 5
scope: Read-only provider log diagnosis; message indicators only, no headers or raw messages retained. No recovery or restart implied.
